name: helpapaw-firestore-rules-tests
description: Emulator-backed unit tests for firestore.rules. Run these before deploying rules to help-a-paw-dev (which is production).

scripts.test: JAVA_HOME="$(./find-jdk21.sh)" firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project help-a-paw-test "$(command -v node) --test"
